recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11391 unless the work group separately reopens the later FHIR-29688 root diagnosisRelatedGroup model decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11391 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking for a consistent ExplanationOfBenefit term for DRG, bundle, or equivalent package billing codes. The final resolution narrowed the applied request to renaming the diagnosis drg element to packageCode.
initial_application: Historical commit d06f8787e65d9eb23bd903d44c86c650b2fac541 applied trackers #11375, #11376, #11391, and #11392 by changing the old ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheet source from ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.drg to ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.packageCode and updating its short, definition, and requirements text.
additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is active in source/fhir.ini, but the current XML source no longer contains ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.drg or ExplanationOfBenefit.diagnosis.packageCode. Published FHIR-29688 later required diagnosisRelatedGroup at the Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit roots and removal of resource.diagnosis.packageCode; commit acb64eec3ca82f9a8d18d4091f2416029ee45dcd implemented that later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing diagnosis-level packageCode or reverting the current root diagnosisRelatedGroup terminology would conflict with the later final FHIR-29688 model, while the obsolete drg element requested by FHIR-11391 is absent from current EOB source.
